text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back to the academy, I
invite
Kawakami Princess to see a stage
performance at
a theme park.

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then let us dance, my dear prince—until
the
morning star rises!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wooow... What a lovely show that was!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I did indeed! I had always wanted to see
that
show. Thank you for bringing me
along.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That elaborate dress the princess wore
as she
danced with the prince...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Was nothing compared to how agile her
steps
were! Those bold maneuvers and
powerful
twists—it was spectacular!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The dress was wonderful too, of course!
One of
the reasons I started admiring
princesses was
seeing Princess Fighter's
dress.
choice_data_list: ドレスより、ダンスなんだな
ドレスより、ダンスなんだね

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Its spellbinding sparkle gripped my
innocent little
heart. But...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of a princess is not just
about
appearances!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What truly makes a princess dazzle is her

unyielding effort.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've come to understand that feeling
more and
more ever since I entered
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I can only imagine the amount of sheer
grit and
determination the princess
today put into her
dance...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's that very effort which makes her so

breathtaking! In my eyes, she is a true
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Where did that come from?
You're going
to make me blush!
choice_data_list: それなら、君もお姫様だな
それなら、貴方もお姫様だね
choice_data_list_en: In that case, you're a princess too.
In that case, that makes you a princess too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Besides... The reason I can work so hard
is
because you're—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the previously dark stage is lit
once
again, and the princess elegantly
makes her
appearance.

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
The party is not over yet! Now then,
everyone,
let's dance together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my, oh my! What a lovely encore!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I must hurry and—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Mama, I don't know how to dance.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know if I'm comfortable
dancing
either...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't anyone else dancing? And
after we
received such a delightful
invitation...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Really? But dancing is about expressing
your
feelings. There's nothing wrong
with being bold
and dancing freely!
choice_data_list: 一緒に、お手本を見せよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's show them how it's done together!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That girl is so pretty when she
spins around.
She's like the princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, would you like to dance together,
my little
princess?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: But... I don't know how...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry—I'll teach you. ♪ Come,
you
princesses over there can join in too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now then! Watch me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the radiance you've helped me
acquire
and share it with everybody, as a
princess should!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Wooow! This is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess lifts the children up
into her
arms, and they begin a pleasant
dance together.
Her gallant figure
invites cheers from the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's a fantastic idea! Just like you
revealed the
princess road to me,
tonight we'll do the same for
everyone
else.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay, Trainer, give me your hand.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll show that taking the lead in a dance
is no
problem for one fit to be a
princess! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! We'll take it nice and slow!
I won't go
throwing you into the air or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Okay. One, two, three... One, two,
three...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this is just like we're dancing at a
real
ball. ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! U-um... Would you dance with me
too,
princess?

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. Let's dance together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how much fun Kawakami Princess
is having
encourages the audience to
follow her lead. This
night will make for
a great memory.
